subject: Claude: Unequal Crossing generator packet ready (interface)
body:
# Claude overnight 4 October 2026

Session: scheduled `overnight handoff notes polling` (Claude). State: IN_PROGRESS.

## Claims (mailbox claim UNEQUAL-CROSSING-20261004)
New files only: `expeditions/v2/generation/unequal-crossing.js`, `expeditions/v2/generation/unequal-crossing.test.js`, this report. No shared topology/index/runtime-bank/active-file edits.

## Log
- Read handoff, scrum packet and mailbox; acknowledged scrum message 1791142576367-9283d02a0be4.
- Unequal Crossing generator written (see below).

## Unequal Crossing generator packet (batch 1): READY_FOR_REVIEW
Files: `expeditions/v2/generation/unequal-crossing.js`, `unequal-crossing.test.js`. Not wired into `generation/index.js`, topology, runtime-bank or any bank; nothing is enabled and no candidate is certified (`certified:false`).

Interface (for Codex coding/bank work):
- `generateUnequalPuzzle({tier,seed,controlHex})` -> `{status,puzzle,mathematicalEvidence,puzzleFingerprint}`
- `generateUnequalCrossingCandidate({tier,seed,layoutId})` -> full schema-valid blueprint (`familyId:'unequal-crossing'`, `puzzle.kind:'balance'`, outputs `balance-crossing` (on-commit passage) and `reserve-benefit` (phase-start), hazard `scale-drain` mutation `puzzle`, commission `{poweredIds:['balance-crossing']}`).
- `unequalCrossingOutputs()`.

Rules implemented (spec section 6): six loads values 1..12; solution-first partitions with exact usedCount/reserveCount (T1 6; T2 4 or 5; T3-5 4..6); target = pan capacity; T1 maxPanCount 4 each, no pairs; T2-5 one or two incompatible pairs drawn from loads on different solution pans, each proven to remove at least one otherwise-valid partition; T3-5 exactly one hidden load, in the final allocation, with 3/4/5 candidates and allowance 2/3/3; every attempt enumerates all 3^6 allocations, requires the generated solution among them, counts mirror-reduced partitions (left/right symmetry not double counted), rejects hidden states where fewer than 2 candidates admit any valid allocation (inferable by solvability alone), and requires `solveWeighing` to prove a decision tree within the allowance (tests also replay the tree for every candidate and show allowance-1 is not distinguishable at T4).

Evidence: `node --test expeditions/v2/generation/unequal-crossing.test.js` 6 pass. Independent 3^6 enumeration agrees with the production solver counts. Planner (C-08A) wins through the real reducer on real candidates: T2 seed1 Cornix/Kernel/Beeswax (683 states, 33 cmds), T3 seed1 and seed2 Barrow/Cobweb/Amberly (4837 / 521 states); T2 seed2 is unknown at 20000 states (not an impossibility claim). T1 and T5 seeds: some topology seeds return `unknown` `unequal-crossing-invalid` (crossing-exit invariant), same attrition mechanism as Four Locks.

Decisions I made that Sam/scrum may override:
1. Reserve-benefit shield targets are `['shape','sustain']` (the two physical scale stations per spec section 6). Earlier engine test fixture used number+shape.
2. Pan capacity equals the target (any larger cap is unreachable because both pans must total the target exactly).
3. T1 cap-binding is not required: the spec reference weights [1,2,3,4,5,7] target 11 do not bind a cap of 4 either; recorded as evidence only.

Still open (not done): two-target-band-team plus alcove-route certification per candidate, bank construction/diversity certification, topology/tier registration, runtime-bank wiring, tiers' enemy/stat tuning beyond Four Locks defaults, UI beyond Codex's BalancePanel.

## Next
Remaining Claude queue: planner two-team validation of Unequal candidates; Turning Ravine tiers 2-5 (legacy released the files); other family packets; final-build lock work when Codex UI/art inputs are stable.
